channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: The Data Center Backlash Bursts Into the Midterms
item.description: With opposition to the centers mounting, many Democrats and a growing number of Republicans are campaigning against them.

item.title: NPR: Body cam shows federal agent was 'unjustified' in Memphis shooting, attorney says
item.description: The family of Jonah Neal and their attorney were recently shown video from the day that Neal was shot by a federal agent while he experienced a mental health crisis.

item.title: BBC News: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
item.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘So many people say things about my appearance – it’s not normal’: Jorja Smith on burnout, body-shaming and finding freedom
item.description: Being recognised by the Brits, Grammys and Drake made the singer one of British music’s most famous names – and also left her exhausted. Now, after decompressing in her home town she returns with a record made for raving…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Israeli air strike near Gaza refugee camp kills one person and injures two
item.description: Israeli air attack near Gaza's Maghazi camp kills one person and injures two others.

item.title: Ars Technica: Putting mice into hibernation causes a major loss of synapses
item.description: Hibernation cuts down on synapses, but mice seem to retain memories anyway.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Teen ‘After-Prom’ Kings in LA Monetized the High School Rager
item.description: The West Coast house-party scene has long been iconic. For these young, tech-savvy entrepreneurs, it was also inspiration for MyPlots, a party-promotion empire.

item.title: WIRED Science: Is Expensive Bottled Water Actually Better for You?
item.description: Luxury water can contain different minerals and taste noticeably different. But a remote source, alkaline pH, and high price do not necessarily mean better hydration.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
item.description: Cheap energy, abundant land, and proximity to Beijing have turned a city in Inner Mongolia into a crucial hub for data centers.

item.title: The New Yorker: Sean Duffy in the Real World
item.description: Donald Trump’s Transportation Secretary got his big break on reality TV, and is now out with a six-part YouTube show about a family road trip. How bad could it be?

New York Mag Curbed: This Old, Very Old, Hamptons House
item.description: The restoration of an 18th-century cottage in the Springs proves worthy of its rich bohemian past.
